lines.text: Many learners say: The cars are expensives.
Words like expensive never get s.

data.why: Words like expensive never get s.

native.tip: En español decimos “caros”, pero en inglés “expensive” nunca lleva -s.
native.caption: 🙈 Error común: “The cars are expensives.” Sobra la “s”, porque “expensive” no cambia. Lo correcto es “The cars are expensive.” ¡Escucha a Ama y repite! Practica más en la app Lexkite.
native.comment: Respuesta: “expensive”. En inglés los adjetivos no cambian: “expensive” sirve para uno o para varios. Escribe una frase tuya con “expensive” o dila en voz alta: {link}

en.tip: Learners say “caros”, but “expensive” never takes an s in English.
en.caption: Common mistake: “The cars are expensives.” The “s” is extra, because “expensive” never changes. Say “The cars are expensive.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
